title: Crypt (Badlands)
wikitext:
[[File:Badlands Crypt.jpg|thumb|300px|The Crypt's entrance]]

The [[Badlands]] '''Crypt''' is located southeast of [[Hammertoe's Digsite]], at the top of the hill behind [[Sigrun Ironhew]]. Entrance to it is via a natural and unmarked path up the hill. The bottom of the Crypt contains a number of urns, chests, and skeletons, with the centerpiece being an armored skeleton seated on a throne with the [[Sword of the Barbarian King]] next to it. The ghost of [[Marauder King Corthan]] haunts the crypt still, trapped by the Lord of Everlasting Death's curse.

==Trivia==
*This place is a reference to the {{Wp|Conan the Barbarian}} story "{{Wp|The Thing in the Crypt}}", in which Conan finds a crypt and takes the sword of a mummified king sitting on a throne. This also inspired a scene in the 1982 film ''{{Wp|Conan the Barbarian (1982 film)|Conan the Barbarian}}''.
